messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: prod-gateway error rate spike detected. 5xx > 3% sustained for 4m, latency p95 up. Auto-pager sent to #oncall.

sara nguyen: Paging team — I'm oncall. seeing 5xx from gateway -> service-proxy and a lot of 429s from rate-limiter. Triage started. :rotating_light:

matthew cole: on my way, grabbing logs. quick question: is this global or region-specific?

oliver zhang: looks global from the aggregated dashboard. error breakdown: 52% gateway 502, 30% gateway timeout (504), 18% 429 from quota service.

lina park: adding initial impact: ~12% of requests in US-west are failing, some customers report timeouts in chat and embeddings. Using /incidents/impact matrix to collect affected tenants.

jessica k.: I'm watching the quota controller metrics — there was a config rollout ~10:20UTC that updated per-tenant caps. It failed halfway and the sync job retried, then pushed a global cap value to the Redis shard. suspect misapplied caps.

incident-bot: Deploy/rollout event: config-service v2.14.3 -> config-sync job triggered at 3305000900. No automatic rollback.

sara nguyen: Action plan: 1) revert config-sync to previous commit 2) scale rate-limiter horizontally temporarily 3) enable bypass for high-priority tenants 4) gather customer impact list and notify CS. Who can run the rollback?

matthew cole: I can roll back the config-sync. Preparing rollback command now. patch rollback cmd:
```
kubectl -n infra set image deployment/config-sync config-sync=myorg/config-sync:v2.14.2
# follow with /ops/run health-check config-sync
```

oliver zhang: I'll scale rate-limiter pool to +3 instances and put it in warmup mode to accept queued token bursts.

lina park: I'll start the high-priority bypass for critical customers. list coming in a sec.

jessica k.: Running quick verification: sampling logs from rate-limiter shard-03 shows global cap key set to "100" (single value) instead of per-tenant map. Here's the snippet: 
```
[2026-03-15T10:23:11Z] quota-sync: writing global_cap=100 to /kv/tenant_caps
[2026-03-15T10:23:12Z] quota-enforcer: loaded cap=100 for tenant=all
[2026-03-15T10:23:12Z] rate-limiter: reject 429 tenant=alpha, tenant=beta
```

matthew cole: Rollback in progress. I'll flip image, then force a sync-fetch on config-service. Expect 30–45s for new config to propagate.

incident-bot: ACTION: matthew cole started rollback at 3305001302.

sara nguyen: While rollback completes: temporary mitigation — increase gateway request timeout to 20s and route non-critical background traffic to a best-effort pool. Adding a rule to drop excessive retry loops.

oliver zhang: rate-limiter scaled +3 (pods 6 -> 9), warmup flag set. Observability: queue depth falling, 5xx trending down to 1.8% in 2m.

lina park: bypass applied for tenants: alpha-corp, beta-saas, gamma-enterprise (ids: t-0192, t-4491, t-7750). Notifying CS to contact these customers ASAP.

jessica k.: Rollback verified: config-sync v2.14.2 restored and per-tenant cap map rehydrated. key /kv/tenant_caps now contains map, not scalar.

matthew cole: Confirmed propagation. Manual trigger to reload config on all quota-enforcer instances done. Running quick smoke tests against alpha-corp and beta-saas.

oliver zhang: Smoke tests: alpha-corp OK, beta-saas OK, gamma-enterprise OK. 5xx now down to 0.5% and 429s dropping.

sara nguyen: Customer impact summary for pager:
- Window: 10:22–10:39 UTC
- Peak affected traffic: ~14% requests with elevated latency/errors
- Major error types: 502/504 (gateway/backpressure) and 429 (misapplied global quotas)
- Root cause: config-sync rollout bug that wrote a scalar cap to shared KV, applying a single cap to all tenants
- Mitigation: rollback config-sync, scale rate-limiter, enable bypass for priority tenants, increase gateway timeout temporarily

lina park: CS notified: drafted message and sent to account leads for affected tenants. No major data loss, degraded availability only.

jessica k.: Postmortem TODOs: add validation in config-sync to reject scalar writes to tenant_caps, add canary checks, add automated rollback on config-write anomalies, and add an alert for sudden global cap writes.

matthew cole: Logging a follow-up oncall action item: rotate the quota-sync job to run as a blue/green job instead of direct write.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED for alert id: alert-330500-01 at 3305001615. Closing pager.

sara nguyen: Thanks everyone. I'll create the postmortem and link dashboards. If anyone has additional logs or customer messages, drop them here. :heart:
